svg.text: Z gearing is stock: the LDO Klipper config carries [stepper_z] rotation_distance: 40 and gear_ratio: 80:16. Four identical drives, two 'a' and two

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 'b'. The Z idler's pulley must face the same way as the 20T in the drive directly below it, or the Z belt does not run in one plane. A tooth visible

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on the outside of either vertical run means the belt is twisted (Ch 06).
